{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Knit top: fitted crew neck, hip length, ivory (#f3ece0), fine merino wool
Skirt: A-line, mid-calf length, deep navy (#26324a), wool crepe
Jacket: single-breasted blazer, slightly fitted, hip length, dusty blue-grey (#8a9bb0), textured bouclé tweed
Coat: straight cut, knee length, camel (#b58f68), soft wool-cashmere blend
Ankle boots: sleek pointed toe, low block heel, black (#1c1a1c), smooth leather
Bag: small structured crossbody, burgundy (#6b2433), matte leather
Earrings: small drops, pearl white (#f2ede4), freshwater pearl with a gold-toned setting

This outfit suits a neat theatre evening: a refined knit with a skirt and a textured jacket is polished without looking like office wear. The dusty blue-grey of the jacket echoes the cool tone of your eyes, while the ivory knit brings softness near your face against your dark hair. The A-line midi skirt and block-heeled boots stay comfortable through a long performance and the walk there. The camel coat adds warmth for the autumn evening air and can be left in the cloakroom, leaving a tidy, elegant look under the artificial light of the foyer and auditorium."}
